frozen_protocol_clarification.company_identity: Exact strong identifier OR at least two independent medium identifiers; mandatory second review of every medium/manual match. Name alone is insufficient and conflicting strong identity must not be overridden.
frozen_protocol_clarification.funded_layer_b: Adjudicated, source-bound successful financing producing an investment/security position plus successful completion/close date. Coherent public aggregate evidence can establish this; individual private executed securities/receipts are not universal prerequisites.
frozen_protocol_clarification.economic_round: Same issuer, comparable instrument/terms and overlapping raise window; resolve source-bound amendments, tranches, cohosts and known conflicts at the claim-specific scope.
frozen_protocol_clarification.preserved_document_scope: An unsigned template alone still does not prove completed funding. Earlier PDF-only unknowns remain correct for those reviews; new campaign/timeline/identity bindings provide additional evidence.
frozen_protocol_clarification.individual_terms: Exact operative investor terms remain necessary when material to the particular identity/comparability/return claim; their absence is not a blanket veto of every aggregate observed funded row.
frozen_protocol_clarification.collector_default_flags: CP10 initializes identity_verified/estimation_eligible false before adjudication. These defaults are not 568 independent scientific rejections and must not be mass-toggled to true.
frozen_protocol_clarification.independent_frozen_rule_checks_scope: 13 synthetic behavior checks of frozen implementation; not empirical company outcomes or full-study verification.
